items.title: Tiny microcontroller runs a real LLM
items.oneliner: ESP32-S3 project runs a 28.9M parameter LLM at about 9 tokens per second for fully offline edge inference.

items.title: Postgres testing without Docker
items.oneliner: Python library spins up fresh PostgreSQL instances with pip, templates, and pytest support, no Docker, Brew, or apt.

items.title: Ruff now catches far more bugs
items.oneliner: Python linter update raises default checks from 59 to 413 and adds Markdown code block formatting.

items.title: Fast duplicate finder for huge disks
items.oneliner: Parallel duplicate-file detector scans large disks quickly, with TUI, export options, and safe delete confirmation.

items.title: Build a desk radar with ESP32
items.oneliner: Hands-on ESP32-C3 project displays nearby aircraft with ADS-B data, browser flashing, OTA updates, and enclosure files.

items.title: Rust integration tests with disposable infrastructure
items.oneliner: Practical Rust guide shows RAII-based integration tests using Docker containers that clean themselves up automatically.

items.title: Learn Zig through runnable examples
items.oneliner: Annotated Zig examples cover core syntax, error handling, async patterns, and C interop for hands-on language learning.

items.title: Self-host servers from your living room
items.oneliner: Detailed Linux networking tutorial shows static-IP home hosting with L2TP tunneling for Gitea, CGIT, or Raspberry Pi services.

items.title: Minimal shell history with SQLite
items.oneliner: Small Go tool replaces bloated shell history managers with local SQLite search, import, and session-agnostic recall.

items.title: Build a mechanical television yourself
items.oneliner: Open hardware repo includes parts, wiring, firmware, and assembly steps for a Raspberry Pi Pico mechanical TV.
